headline: Sensex Closes Mixed as Adani Soars and IT Stocks Drag
why: Jefferies bullish report triggered a major surge in Adani group stocks.
IT sector faced selling pressure ahead of the upcoming US Fed rate decision.
Pre-market Call Auction System (CAS) volatility caused extreme intra-day swings.
Rupee weakness against the USD weighed on broad market sentiment.
whatHappening: Sensex ended 22 points lower while Nifty gained 53 points to close above 23,300.
Adani group shares jumped up to 12% following up to 53% upside price targets.
Realty and metal stocks gained up to 2%, contrasting with a 1.5% drop in IT.
Bodal Chemicals and other commodity stocks touched new 52-week highs.

stocksInNews.sources: Jefferies sees up to 53% upside potential in Adani Energy
Adani group stocks surged up to 12% on bullish analyst views
Hit 52-week high after rallying up to 175% in a month
IT sector dragged market down over 1.5% ahead of Fed call
IT stocks faced selling pressure ahead of US Fed rate decision
Realty sector gained nearly 2% leading broader market gains
Metals sector shined during the trading session
FMCG sector gained strength ahead of US Fed rate decision
Sensex closed flat after intra-day volatility in heavyweights
Index heavyweights helped keep Nifty positive above 23,300

summary:
Indian benchmark indices ended mixed as Nifty crossed 23,300 while Sensex closed slightly in the red.
Adani Group stocks rallied sharply up to 12% following bullish target upgrades by Jefferies.
Realty, metals, and FMCG sectors gained strength, whereas IT stocks dragged the market down ahead of the US Fed decision.
